purpose: Wave 1 claim register. Each row records a statement that appears or is proposed in customer-facing surfaces, where it comes from, how it was verified, the wording permitted today, what must not be said, and whether it may be released. Verification values are literal: 'read-in-code' means the file was read this session; 'unverified' means no check has been performed.

claims.statement: Delivered in 3 working days.
claims.allowed_wording: State a delivery period only once one has been agreed with the buyer at scoping. Until then: 'Delivery period agreed at scoping.'
claims.exclusion: Do not present 3 working days as an established service level; no delivery has been performed against it.

claims.statement: 353 locations, 329 providers, 25 selected organisations.
claims.allowed_wording: Quote these figures only labelled as the Birmingham and Solihull sample, with its observation dates.
claims.exclusion: Do not present them as typical territory volumes or as evidence of fit for a different buyer or region.

claims.statement: Ranked shortlist of 25–50 priority organisations, each with a stated reason.
claims.allowed_wording: Releasable once each selection carries a buyer-specific reason and a source. The sample currently carries generic reasons.
claims.exclusion: Do not imply the reasons are tailored to the reader's question before scoping has happened.

claims.statement: Current edition available immediately after the delivery gates pass.
claims.allowed_wording: Already correctly conditional. Keep the gate clause attached; it may not be shortened to 'available immediately'.
claims.exclusion: No unconditional availability claim until an edition has actually been produced and delivered in a test.

claims.statement: 20–35 page current-edition report covering registrations, closures and rating movements.
claims.allowed_wording: Describe as the planned edition scope until one checked edition exists.
claims.exclusion: Do not state a page count or coverage as delivered fact before an edition is produced. Source comparability across editions has not been established.

claims.statement: Four weekly digest deliveries for £150.
claims.allowed_wording: Honour exactly as offered to the three recorded contacts.
claims.exclusion: No new pilot sends without a fresh decision. Do not rename it a one-provider or five-provider audit. 'No verified changes' may never be rendered as 'data unavailable', and vice versa.

claims.statement: 10 saved views, 90-day canonical event export, 2 organization users, email and in-app delivery.
claims.allowed_wording: Present as the intended scope of a product not yet available.
claims.exclusion: These limits have not been tested. Do not present them as working features, and do not show a counter, freshness badge or match count on any Radar surface that is not derived from an actual completed run.

claims.statement: Everything in Radar Regional across all England, 365-day export, 5 users, structured onboarding.
claims.allowed_wording: Present as intended scope only.
claims.exclusion: National coverage is not established by a regional sample. Onboarding does not exist.

claims.statement: Timestamped, signed webhooks; stable cursors; idempotent replay; delivery health.
claims.allowed_wording: Documentation may describe the intended contract, with every schema example labelled illustrative.
claims.exclusion: Signing, replay and delivery health are unimplemented as far as this register can show. Do not describe them in the present tense.

claims.statement: Contracted SLA, support and deployment scope; procurement, security and data-processing review.
claims.allowed_wording: Describe as what a future engagement would require, not what is offered.
claims.exclusion: Appearing in copy is not evidence that a security review process, SLA or white-label delivery exists.

claims.statement: Browse profiles, ratings, source dates and official links.
claims.allowed_wording: Releasable once identity, category, geography and rating rendering are checked against records.
claims.exclusion: A colour badge must not imply current compliance. Blank rating, Not Rated and not-inspected are three distinct states.

claims.statement: CareGist is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Care Quality Commission.
claims.allowed_wording: Carry on every product surface that displays CQC-derived data.
claims.exclusion: None. This line must not be dropped during visual polishing.

claims.statement: Roadmap products present a disabled control and the line 'No purchase or paid checkout is available for this product.'
claims.allowed_wording: Accurate for the pricing card. The GATED_TIERS branch returns a disabled button before any checkout branch is reachable, so a roadmap tier cannot transition to payment from this component.
claims.exclusion: This was verified for the pricing card only. Other entry points, including /signup?plan=, have not been audited and no site-wide 'no checkout path exists' claim may be made yet.

claims.statement: Statutory, forensic, audited and clinical framing carried by the supplied design reference.
claims.allowed_wording: Adopt the visual system; describe the work as checked comparisons of a public register.
claims.exclusion: Remove this vocabulary from customer-facing copy. No invented team, byline, signature, testimonial, fulfilment status or demand metric.

claims.statement: VAT treatment and public totals.
claims.allowed_wording: Keep VAT recorded as unknown in internal preparation.
claims.exclusion: Do not compute or display a public total from an assumed VAT position.

claims.statement: Free tier 'Built for evaluation: browse providers, test the data, and monitor one provider.' shown alongside limit summary 'Directory access'.
claims.allowed_wording: Describe only what the directory does. The two strings must agree.
claims.exclusion: 'Monitor one provider' is a monitoring claim that the free limit summary ('Directory access') contradicts. It must not ship until a monitoring capability on the free tier is verified to exist.

claims.statement: Dashboard describes 'two verified launch signals', saved views and event export in the present tense as tier features.
claims.allowed_wording: None in the present tense while these products are held closed.
claims.exclusion: Same gate as CLM-7 and CLM-8. Copy in an entitlement panel is not evidence the ingest, dedup, saved views or export exist.

conflicts.summary: Live Stripe product and price IDs exist for radar-regional (£299/mo), radar-national (£799/mo) and intelligence-feed (£6,000/yr), and deploy/stripe-price-manifest.json sets checkout_enabled: true, while the founder decision holds all three closed and the public catalogue shows 'Request access · no paid checkout'.
conflicts.current_mitigation: The pricing card's GATED_TIERS branch returns a disabled control before the checkout call, so these prices are not reachable from that surface (CLM-13).
conflicts.residual_risk: The mitigation is presentational. Live prices remain purchasable by anyone who reaches the billing endpoint another way; that has not been audited.
conflicts.action: Founder decision required: archive the live prices, or confirm they stay and audit every route into /api/v1/billing/checkout. Out of scope for visual polishing.

conflicts.summary: The supplied design reference contains two disagreeing palettes.
conflicts.current_mitigation: Resolved in artifacts/product-polish/DESIGN.md; the prose palette wins because every component spec depends on it.
conflicts.residual_risk: None once implementation reads DESIGN.md rather than the reference file.

conflicts.summary: app/dashboard/page.tsx builds its free-tier panel from the legacy 'free' keys: cta 'Compare Radar plans' and next-step 'Radar Regional turns verified CQC changes into an evidence-linked team workflow.' Both steer users toward a product the founder decision holds closed. The free branch is also the fallback (tierInfo[tier] || tierInfo.free), so any unrecognised tier renders it too.
conflicts.current_mitigation: None. This is a live reader at app/dashboard/page.tsx:254-259, not dead configuration.
conflicts.residual_risk: Logged-in free users, and any user on an unrecognised tier, are pointed at Radar as though it were purchasable.
conflicts.action: Wave 3: repoint the free-tier CTA at the two launch products (Brief lead, Report second) and rewrite PLAN_NEXT_STEP.free. Do not simply delete the key while the fallback depends on it.

wave1_check.note: Original Wave 1 checks describe the September 8 code review. CLM-18–28 were later historical additions asserting external live-query/draft checks; those assertions were not independently reproduced in the October 1 archival review and remain blocked.

review_scope: Local archival review only. Historical live-query assertions are retained as reported, not independently verified. New claims remain blocked pending accessible evidence and independent review.
